seo.title: Contrast — Sauna + Cold Plunge Timer for iOS
seo.description: A simple, purpose-built timer for contrast therapy. HealthKit integration, smart protocols, Apple Watch support. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: SAUNA + COLD PLUNGE
hero.title: Contrast therapy, timed.
text: A purpose-built timer for sauna and cold plunge sessions. HealthKit sync, smart protocols, Apple Watch support.

items.title: Quick Start
items.text: Two taps to start timing. Sauna or cold plunge — pick one and go. Designed for wet hands and foggy glasses.

items.title: Smart Protocols
items.text: Multi-phase session plans that guide you through sauna, cold plunge, and rest intervals with automatic transitions.

items.title: HealthKit Sync
items.text: Sessions save to Apple Health as workouts automatically. Your contrast therapy shows up alongside everything else you track.

items.title: Session History
items.text: Every session is saved. Track personal records, total exposure time, and build the consistency that drives results.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: Start, pause, and advance phases from your wrist. Haptic alerts tell you when it's time to switch — no phone needed.

items.title: Completely Offline
items.text: No servers, no cloud sync, no network requests. Your data stays on your device. Period.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Contrast doesn't even make network requests. Your session data lives on your device and nowhere else.

cta.title: Start your session.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
